string.text: Press this key with the inventory open to top up incomplete Mags Reloaded Loadout magazines. Marked magazines use Mags Reloaded's FMJ/AP/HP/buck/slug classifier; empty marked magazines can be filled too.

Range: 0.25-5.00. Without AML, 1.00 uses Mags Reloaded's load delay. With AML (Animated Magazine Loading), animation speed is capped at 2.0. Adjust its base speed in Mags Reloaded MCM > AML Load Animation Speed; values above 2.00 here cannot exceed AML's cap.

Scans current Loadout magazines and loose ammo. Unmarked magazines are grouped by loaded ammo type, and single-magazine groups can still be filled from matching boxes. Uses box ammo first; unloads only the minimum surplus rounds needed when boxes alone cannot balance the magazines. Off by default.
Choose whether balancing uses the regular Autoload key or its own key.
Used only when the separate balancing key is selected. Default: N.
Mix compatible ammo types while balancing

Off by default: balance exact ammo groups separately and respect magazine marks. On: prefer the magazine's dominant loaded ammo; use other compatible types only when it runs out, regardless of magazine marks.
Enable unload magazines outside Loadout action
Press the configured key (default C) to unload loaded magazines not marked as Loadout in Mags Reloaded. Loadout magazines are never touched. Off by default.
Default: C. Only active when the unload-all option is enabled.
Choose English or Polish for Mags Autoload notifications and reports.

Applies only to marked magazines. Skip leaves mags with a different ammo class untouched. Mix adds the marked class alongside existing rounds. Replace returns current rounds to inventory, then loads the marked class.
Show or hide the final summary after autoload finishes or is cancelled. Start and error messages remain visible.
Log every key pressed in the inventory and autoload results to the game log. Off by default.
